scope: Prototype outreach ordering, not clinical urgency or an operational-status prediction
svi_pct: 2022 nationally ranked tract SVI, joined by exact Census-returned tract GEOID
empower_density_pct: Midrank of the ZIP DME/Medicare ratio among unique county ZIP rows with unmasked counts; source-reported 11 masking markers are refused
cms_risk: (5 - source CMS stars) / 4, requiring a rating between 1 and 5
plan_context: Not used. No county plan value is guessed or copied from Manatee.
geography: Exact Census address match and source point covered by official county geometry. NWS counties are primary; current Census geometry explicitly supplements missing county codes.
tie_break: Descending score, facility type, then source CCN
